quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got some other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. I'll go get someone else to help. That said, it's been quite dangerous outside lately.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Please remember to <color=#00E1FFFF>avoid getting hit by any element</color> while you're on your way. Be careful now, and don't get hurt.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Hardworking Silio

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Oh wow, thanks, you're finally here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Well, here's what happened. Silio ordered a serving of Mondstadt Hash Brown, and said that he'd like it delivered around this time.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This hash brown is particularly fragile. If you shake it too much, it might fall apart. <color=#00E1FFFF>Please deliver it in time</color> so that it can maintain its crumbly mouthfeel.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If something happens to you out there, please bring that serving back, and I'll prepare a new one for you.

dialogues.speaker: Hardworking Silio
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm famished. That was the only meal I was having today...
